item.title: This oddball reflective lava world is challenging to understand
item.description: Among Kepler and TESS's many surprising exoplanet discoveries are the ultra-short-period (USP) planets. These planets move very quickly and complete an orbit in less than 24 hours. Ancient astronomers thought that Mercury was so fast—it goes around the sun every 88 days—that they named it after the Roman god Mercury, who was the fast-traveling messenger of the gods. They couldn't have known how sluggish Mercury is compared to the USPs. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies sweep Europe
item.description: France is preparing for a third weekend of protests, with 70,000 security personnel deployed to prevent a repeat of the violence seen on October 17. Shops have boarded up their premises as authorities warn of further clashes, with Halloween adding to concerns over masked demonstrators. The protests, initially driven by anger over the cost of living and poor school conditions, have broadened to include demands for greater civil liberties and the right to protest. With presidential elections six months away, authorities have tightened security and restricted demonstrations in several cities. Publicado también por: CNBC - World, NPR - World, France 24 - English. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Concluye la evacuación de civiles de Oleshky tras una tregua humanitaria sin precedentes
item.description: Mientras continúa la invasión rusa en la mayor parte de Ucrania, una tregua humanitaria excepcional ha permitido este 31 de octubre completar la evacuación de civiles desde Oleshky, una ciudad ocupada por Moscú, en la región de Jersón, en el sur. La pausa local de seis días, descrita como la primera de estas características desde el inicio de la invasión rusa a gran escala en 2022, permitió el regreso a territorio controlado por Ucrania de residentes que, según los testimonios recogidos durante la evacuación, llevaban meses sufriendo una grave escasez de alimentos y suministros.
